//: Bun resolves tsconfig paths from the tsconfig nearest the IMPORTING file, not from the entrypoint's. Verified: with a tsconfig only under products/, a file in solutions/ that imports @carbon/* fails to resolve. So this tree needs its own.
//options: The compiler options are repeated from products/carbon-cli/tsconfig.json rather than inherited, because .config/tsconfig.base.json carries only the path aliases — it is the wiring both trees share, not a compiler profile. Without allowImportingTsExtensions the whole tree reports 'an import path can only end with .ts', since every internal import is explicit about the extension.
//include: A single recursive glob, not a list of top-level folders. The folder list went stale the moment the tiers were renamed, and a stale include reports 'No inputs were found' pointing at line 1 — which reads like a syntax error and is not. This form cannot go stale while any .ts exists.
